svg.text: WEIGHT across, PUSH down. Every cell is a real master build, not an interpolation.
PUSH moves thin and thick apart around a fixed mean, so it changes contrast at near-constant colour.
wght 280 is Thin and 800 is Black; the axis runs continuously between them.
The buildable region is mapped in measure/bowl_region.py -- the bowl letters set the limits, not the diagonals.
